cards.text: The prophet Jeremiah is still carrying the LORD's message about Babylon, and it is NOT good news for Babylon. Right in the middle of it, the LORD calls out to His own: 'My people!'

cards.question: The LORD calls out to His people living in Babylon. What does He tell them to do?
Why does the LORD tell His people to get out of Babylon?

answers.text: To save their lives from His anger
To bring Babylon's gold back home
To warn the cities around her

cards.text: Then He tells them about the news to come: a rumor one year, another the next, violence in the land and ruler against ruler. That's a group chat blowing up for YEARS, friend.

cards.question: When those rumors of violence and ruler against ruler come, the LORD tells His people to be afraid.

cards.text: The days are coming when the LORD will punish Babylon's idols, and her whole land will suffer shame. Friend, when the LORD puts your idols on the calendar, that is NOT an invite you get to decline.

cards.question: When the destroyers from the north come against Babylon, heaven and earth will mourn over her.

cards.text: Then the LORD says it straight: Babylon must fall. All over the earth, the slain have fallen because of her, and NOW, friend, gravity's coming for Babylon.

cards.question: The LORD says Babylon must fall on account of the slain of ___.

cards.text: Now He speaks up: 'You who have escaped the sword, depart and do not linger!' No snooze button on this one, friend, and no five more minutes.

cards.question: As the ones who escaped the sword head out, the LORD tells them what to keep in mind: 'Remember the LORD from far away, and let ___ come to mind.'

cards.text: Then voices answer back, and it's heavy: 'We are ashamed because we have heard reproach; disgrace has covered our faces.'

cards.question: Why do the people say disgrace has covered their faces?

answers.text: Foreigners entered the LORD's holy places
Their own king abandoned the city
Their harvest failed two years running

cards.text: So the LORD answers that shame: the days are coming when He will punish her idols, and the wounded will groan throughout her land. That's the SECOND time He's put those idols on notice, and friend, the LORD does not need a reminder app.

cards.question: Even if Babylon climbs to the heavens and fortifies her lofty stronghold, the destroyers the LORD sends will still come against her.

cards.text: Then listen: a cry from Babylon, the sound of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans, Babylon's people. I've hollered over a burnt batch before, friend, but NOTHING like this.

cards.question: The LORD is going to destroy Babylon. What does He say He'll do to her mighty voice?

cards.text: Babylon's mighty voice goes quiet, but the noise isn't over. The waves will roar like great waters, and the tumult of their voices will resound.

A destroyer is coming against Babylon, and her warriors will be captured, their bows broken. A broken bow is about as useful as I was in the junk drawer with my edges worn down, friend, and trust me, THAT'S not useful.

cards.question: Right after Babylon's warriors are captured and their bows broken, the verse calls the LORD a God of retribution. What else does it say He will do?

answers.text: He will give her more time

cards.text: Then the LORD says He'll make her princes and wise men drunk, along with her governors, officials and warriors. That's the WHOLE org chart, friend, from the corner office all the way down to the front desk.

cards.question: After the LORD makes Babylon's leaders drunk, they will sleep it off and wake up the next morning.
This word about Babylon's leaders is declared by the King. What name does the verse give the King?

cards.text: Then the LORD of Hosts speaks about her defenses: Babylon's thick walls will be leveled. Those walls are THICK, friend, and He talks about them like they're cookie crumbs on my counter.

cards.question: Babylon's thick walls get leveled. What happens to her high gates?
With Babylon's walls leveled and her gates burned, the LORD of Hosts says, 'So the labor of the people will be for ___.'

cards.text: The nations will exhaust themselves just to fuel the flames. That's like working overtime all month and watching the boss hit DELETE on your project.
